trial: E6 donor-level coupling of the AREG to EGFR axis in human fibrosis

rules.dataset: GSE136831 (Adams et al. 2020), deposited raw counts and metadata
rules.donors: Subject_Identity, Disease_Identity in IPF or Control; COPD out of scope as in E2
rules.fibroblasts: Manuscript_Identity in Fibroblast or Myofibroblast; pericytes and smooth muscle excluded as mural
rules.measure: fraction of cells with a non-zero count
rules.depth: median deposited nGene per cell, per donor and compartment
rules.activation_score: mean detection of COL1A1, ACTA2, POSTN, CTHRC1, TNC
rules.T8: primary: Spearman, epithelial AREG detection against fibroblast EGFR detection, two-sided alpha 0.05
rules.T9: Spearman, epithelial AREG detection against the fibroblast activation score
rules.T10: ligand control: T8 and T9 recomputed with epithelial TGFA in place of AREG
rules.T11: depth control: if both members of a pair correlate with depth at |rho| >= 0.4, the pair is confounded and is not read
rules.T12: disease-severity control: T8 and T9 within IPF donors only

reading_fixed_in_advance.significant_not_confounded_and_holds_wit: the axis shows donor-level coupling in human fibrotic lung; correlational, no proximity
reading_fixed_in_advance.significant_pooled_but_not_within_ipf: consistent with both variables tracking disease severity; no coupling claim
reading_fixed_in_advance.not_significant: no donor-level coupling detectable at this sample size; report the detectable effect size
reading_fixed_in_advance.tgfa_matches_areg: any coupling is a general EGFR-ligand pattern, not specific to AREG

caveats: a correlation carries no direction and no proximity
the epithelial pool mixes states, so a null could be dilution as in E1b
the IPF donor count bounds the smallest detectable effect
